body: Owner 7 Nov 2026, Opeth 'Benighted': in his build the first lines read 'Come into this night / Here weÂ´ll be gone' (garbled apostrophe) and he cannot tap a line to jump there. Cause (audit B-102, B-103): the text came from the music server's own file tags (double-encoded character, and plain not synced), not from LRCLIB, which has this song synced with a normal apostrophe (checked 7 Nov: 8 synced results). The app trusts the server text, and swaps in LRCLIB's synced version only when its length is within 6 s of the file's. Fix planned inside P1-23: repair double-encoded text at the door; log the lengths; when only the length differs, offer the synced version with the existing timing nudge; say 'not synced' on a plain card. Not proved against his library (his server, not the test VM).
